text:
Introducing Italy’s Finest Coffee & Pastries in Nashua, New Hampshire
United States, August 7, 2025 -- A bold new taste is landing in New Hampshire. Qargo Coffee, the fast-growing brand known for its stylish coffee shops and elevated experience, is opening a brand-new location inside Pheasant Lane Mall, marking the brand’s highly anticipated debut in the Granite State.
Located in one of the region’s busiest shopping destinations, this new coffee spot will bring Qargo’s signature energy and design-forward atmosphere to the heart of Nashua’s commercial hub. With its sleek interiors, thoughtfully crafted menu, and vibrant aesthetic, the new location is set to become a favorite stop for shoppers, professionals, and coffee lovers alike.
It blends Italy’s Finest Coffee & Pastries with bold seasonal drinks and next-level service—delivering an experience that’s both familiar and unexpected. Guests can expect artfully prepared espresso, handcrafted beverages, and premium Italian baked goods, all served in a space designed to inspire creativity, comfort, and connection.
“The Northeast is such a dynamic and diverse region, and Nashua’s energy felt like a perfect match for what Qargo stands for,” said Paola Jimenez, Marketing Manager. “We’re incredibly excited to introduce the brand to New Hampshire and to create a space where people can relax, recharge, and experience coffee the way it was meant to be.”
With its roots in Italian culture and a mission to redefine the modern coffee shop, Qargo Coffee is rapidly expanding into major markets across the U.S.—and each new opening is thoughtfully designed to reflect the unique rhythm of its surroundings. The Nashua store continues that mission, offering a space that feels fresh, stylish, and welcoming to all.
Stay connected by following @qargocoffeeofficial on social media and exploring more at qargocoffee.com . For those interested in bringing Qargo Coffee to a new city, franchise interest forms are now open at qargocoffee.com/franchises/register .
About Qargo Coffee:
Qargo Coffee is a next-generation coffee brand rooted in quality, design, and culture. Known for its elevated aesthetic and commitment to craft, the brand blends the timeless artistry of Italian culture with a modern, purpose-driven experience. From its innovative drink lineup to its thoughtful store environments, Qargo offers more than coffee—it creates spaces that inspire connection, creativity, and community.
About Italian Coffee:
Renowned for its depth, balance, and unmistakable character, Italian coffee remains a global standard of excellence. With roots in espresso tradition and a legacy of meticulous preparation, it offers a sensory experience that transcends trends. Qargo channels this heritage into every cup, preserving the soul of Italian coffee while innovating for contemporary tastes and rhythms.
